description: The BenchBox org is on GitHub Free (20 concurrent jobs). UAT matrices are capped at max-parallel 4/2/3 since #4354 (2026-11-18). Compare one week of queue wait and runner-minutes against the week before, excluding the 15 stuck runs from 2026-11-11 (ids 43098737295, 43098738293, 43098738246, 43098737276, 43098737527, 43098581715, 43098581550, 43098581399, 43098581488, 43098580766, 43098581127, 43098580922, 43098580817, 43098580996, 43098580935), and recommend staying on Free or moving to Team (60 concurrent jobs).
